text:
maria: Quick heads up 1: all-hands in 17. Unexpected: main encoder box in Room G threw an error, moving stream + recording to the mobile rack in Lobby. Presenters please come to Lobby 10 min early for a quick HDMI check. We'll compress the Q&A to 9m.
video-ops: Confirmed. Encoder #g1 reported E_CONN_RESET. Switching to mobile rack (ingest-rack-3) + local OBS on stream-host. Posting new checklist in 2.
jun: Lobby only has one HDMI loop; please bring adapters (usb-c->hdmi, mini-dp->hdmi). I'll bring a spare HDMI splitter.
alex: If we hit encoding issues, fallback is to start raw RTMP to staging: rtmp://ingest-1.internal/allhands. On-call can run: ```ssh stream-host 'systemctl start obs-stream.service'```
pat: Can captions remain on? We had good accuracy last time.
captions-bot: captions: enabled; model=en-rt-large; latency_target=300ms; monitoring enabled.
devon: Slides uploaded: https://drive.redwood/team/all-hands/2026-03-23. Note: moved product roadmap to the follow-up doc. Will publish TL;DR after meeting.
stream-bot: ingest-rack-3 health: CPU 58%, GPU 0%, disk OK, rtmp-handshake: SUCCESS. Backup recorder: READY.
video-ops: Checklist (short): 1) Check HDMI input on mobile rack 2) verify audio device -> Lobby Line In 3) start local OBS test record 4) enable captions 5) confirm viewer URL. If audio levels low: increase preamp +8dB.
maria: For presenters: keep a printed cue card with the 2 main bullets. Also keep camera-facing intro <30s.
jun: Doing a 3s mike test in Lobby now. 
video-ops: Mike test received at -10dBFS, good. Doing a 5s record test: ```ffmpeg -f alsa -i default -t 5 /tmp/test.wav```
alex: If we need to hot-swap laptops, use HDMI switcher input 3 as pre-stage. Cut to holding slide for ~4s during swap.
pat: Remote folks: link stays the same but recording may have a short gap. We'll post final recording link here when available.
maria: Q&A will be shortened to 9min; leftover q's go into #ask-leaders. We'll follow up on any roadmap specifics by Tuesday.
devon: I'll collect unanswered Qs and publish a summary + owner list by EOD tomorrow.
video-ops: Cloud recorder status: PENDING -> STARTED. Viewer URL: https://live.redwood.com/all-hands/1787654321 (may be inactive until cloud ingest stabilizes).
maria: Appreciate the quick pivot. Please join Lobby for mic + HDMI check at T-10. We'll meet for 15m after for a brief retro. :sparkles:
